main_text.p: Diei Veneris, &c. Dies iste appellationem يوم الجمعة Taumol'Jomaa, Sortitus est الناس لاجتماع quòd in eo congregentur homines [scil.ad cultus sacros peragendos:] Magnis diem istum laudibus efferunt, سيد الايام Principem dierum vocantes. Sci-endum autem (inquit AlGazalius) ان هذا اليوم فضل الله به الاسلام وخص به المسلمين Deum huc diem velut honoris praerogativam Islamismo concessisse, eumque Moslemis [seu Mohammedistis] proprium fecisse وجعله عيدا لهم فهم اول الناس بها سبقا p. 30. l. 9. Ebnol Athir in شهر & AlGazal. v.Kazwin: &lib. دشق [?] & illum, festum ipsis constituisse, atque ipsos primos eum observasse. Et خير يوم طلعت عليه الشمس يوم الجمعة Praestantissimum dierum quos superoritur sol, esse diem Veneris. Eo futurum diem judicii autumant, & ut videamus quibus tricis implicetur ipsorum religio, inter cætera quæ de eo nugantur, diem esse تقليم الاظفار praescindis unguibus, præmii à Deo expectandi promisso, commendatum. من قلم اظفاره Qui dies Veneris ungues praeciderit, eum Deus morbo liberatum sanitati restituit. Nuncupabatur olim عروبة A-rubah, quod ait Al Jauharius esse من اسمائهم nominibus eorum antiquis. Ita & Ahmed Iosephi filius كانت العرب تقول ليوم السبت شيار وليومv. Kamuf. & Ebnol Athir. & Al-Iauhar. in هون

page.notes: Arabic words in the main text and notes are transcribed from the scan and marked [?] where the letters are doubtful. The Arabic in the right margin notes is partly unclear. "Moslemis" is printed as shown. Arabic words and the Arabic marginal word are transcribed as far as legible; the exact Arabic spelling of several embedded words is uncertain.
